unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፲ — Meraf 10: Advanced Mastery of ገ and ጠ

success_screen.headline_en: Brilliant! You solved the advanced ገ and ጠ challenges!
success_screen.headline_am: ድንቅ ነው! የላቁትን የገ እና የጠ ፈተናዎችን በብልሃት ጨረሱ!

games.title: Word Assembly: ጋሪ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters to build the word for Cart!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select fourth form 'ጋ', followed by 'ሪ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ጡሩምባ
games.instructions_en: Look at the incomplete word for 'Trumpet': ጡሩ[ ? ]ባ. Choose the correct missing middle letter!
games.tips_en: The full word is ጡሩምባ (pronounced Tu-rum-ba).

games.title: Audio Blend: ገ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the sound blend. Which symbol represents the exact 'Ge' sound?

games.title: Word Assembly: ጡሩምባ
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with 'ጡ', then 'ሩ', then sixth form 'ም', and end with 'ባ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ጋሪ
games.instructions_en: Find the missing letter to complete the word for 'Cart': [ ? ]ሪ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ጋሪ (pronounced Ga-ri).

games.title: Audio Blend: ጠ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely. Which symbol represents the 'T'e' sound?

games.title: Word Assembly: ገበታ
games.tips_en: Tip: Select first form 'ገ', follow with first form 'በ', and end with fourth form 'ታ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ገበታ
games.tips_en: The full word is ገበታ (pronounced Ge-be-ta).
